We claim:

wherein

R1 is alkyl, haloalkyl or cycloalkyl;

R2 is hydrogen, alkyl, haloalkyl or cycloalkyl;

R3 is hydrogen, alkyl or cycloalkyl;

R6 is H, alkyl or cycloalkyl;

R1 is alkyl, haloalkyl or cycloalkyl;

R2 is hydrogen, alkyl, haloalkyl or cycloalkyl;
